heroEyebrow: Financial information for a fairer, more inclusive UK
heroTitle: The money system is not equal.
heroText: Deaf and disabled people can face higher costs, lower pay and inaccessible financial information. We turn the evidence into clear next steps in plain English, with BSL-ready content.
footerText: Information only. We do not provide regulated financial advice. Check eligibility and product terms with the official provider before acting.
